{{Quote|The humans who came as colonists were the first invaders. They drove the native peoples from some of their lands, and were stopped only when their lightning bows and metal birds&mdash;those are their terms, of course&mdash;began to fail.|C-3PO, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
This '''struggle''' between [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists and two native [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], the [[Myneyrsh]] and the [[Psadan]], began after the foreigners crash-landed on the world during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] second wave of expansion. After the colonists crash-landed on Wayland, they interrupted a [[Myneyrsh–Psadan wars|series of wars]] between the two species. The Humans lorded over the natives, using [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] against them, when they had never advanced beyond primitive weapons like [[Bow/Legends|bows]]. This continued for several generations before the Humans ran out of [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]] and were forced to take up arms similar to their opponents. This equalized the conflict that had always favored the Humans. Eventually, the three groups reached an uneasy peace.
